content.comment_body: I have a question about connecting inputs to outputs in [product_name] [version_no]. When trying to set up this connection on a [product_name] [version_no] device, I receive the error: "Recursions only allowed via outputs and Flags". Can someone explain what this means and what I might be doing incorrectly? How can I resolve this issue? I'm new to the [product_name] software and hardware.

Hello [user_name], You’re not making a mistake. The issue comes from how [product_name] processes logic—it doesn’t allow a direct input-to-output connection in this context. I’ve experienced similar challenges when attempting to loop an output back into itself, and the software can't process that either. To solve this, try placing an intermediate memory point (like M) between the recursive connection point and your intended destination. Kind regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users face limitations in [product_name] [version_no], particularly with recursion between inputs and outputs. This results in confusing error messages. New users struggle to understand these constraints and require guidance on correct logic structuring, affecting their initial learning experience.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to connect inputs directly to outputs easily. Clear error messaging and more helpful instructions from the software would support newcomers and improve the learning process.
